ticketed.reason: (a) canopy.json manifest URL. Some readers already apply sanitizeRemoteUrl (projects-list.ts, workspace-metadata-host.ts, core-workspace-adapter.ts), but not every channel is verified, and it travels back on write channels such as projects:save, so redacting it here could overwrite the stored value.
(a) canopy.json repo entry URL can hold a token and round-trips through workspace:init-git.
(b) Plugin marketplace source URL can hold a token and may round-trip through updateMarketplace.
(c) app-advisor:tool-request carries a Git remote URL as action input, unredacted.
(d) MCP server URL in a user-configured or plugin-bundled server can carry a credential in the URL.

Shared container preview. share-preview.ts passes each repository remote through sanitizeRemoteUrl (plan-share-repos.ts), which clears userinfo, query and fragment and drops file: URLs and absolute paths, but no existing test covers the userinfo or token-query case.
(g, new) In-app browser page URL in the resource monitor; a page URL can carry tokens in its query.

User-entered project start page URL (ProjectStartPage kind url); it can carry a token in its query and round-trips through projects:save.

refused.reason: An embedded mcp-servers:start-account mints an authenticated portal link for this computer's cloud account. The host session refuses every controller request on the channel that is not the external sign-in, before it reaches main, so no link is minted or sent; the external sign-in returns no embeddedUrl.
